text:
maria: Build-publisher job failed: vulnerability scan blocked promotion to prod. Trivy exited with code 3. Seen this before?

ben: link to job: <https://ci.internal/builds/4723|build-4723> :eyes:

maria: logs:
```sh
trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --exit-code 3 --format table registry.redwood.net/infra/builder:2024-11
2024-11  registry.redwood.net/infra/builder:2024-11
Total: 1 CRITICAL, 2 HIGH
CRITICAL  CVE-2024-XXXX  openssl  3.0.2-1ubuntu1  remote
```

cara: Looks like openssl packaged by the base distro. Is our builder-base pinned to a digest? If not, tags can drift.

alex: It was published under tag builder:2024-11 (CI pushes both tag + digest), but our promotion step references the tag for human readability — that leaves a window if the registry mirrors are inconsistent.

ops-bot: Registry replication lag detected in eu-west (replicas at 95% sync).

ben: Two options: rebuild with patched packages & re-run SBOM/sign, or pin the gitops image to an existing digest (but that digest contains the vuln). Rebuild seems safer.

maria: Agreed. Plan: rebuild builder image with updated package list, ensure openssl is upgraded, generate SBOM (syft), scan (trivy), sign (cosign), then push and update gitops pin to the new digest.

cara: Commands I used locally to reproduce the SBOM+scan:
```sh
# generate SBOM
syft registry.redwood.net/infra/builder:2024-11 -o json > sbom-2024-11.json
# scan SBOM (trivy can read syft output for provenance checks)
trivy fs --input sbom-2024-11.json --format table
```

alex: Also consider adding an explicit 'require-sbom+signature' step in the promotion job. Right now promotion only gates on vuln-scan exit code. Adding cosign verification will prevent unsigned artifacts from being promoted accidentally.

ben: Operational note: if we rebuild in us-west and push, eu mirror caches could still hand out old layers — we should trigger registry replicate --force for the new digest or push to the eu mirror explicitly. That'll avoid canary pulls getting stale layers.

maria: I'll kick a rebuild in ~10m. Assignments: @alex update gitops pin once new digest is available, @cara verify SBOM + run the trivy scan, @ben run registry replicate after push. Ping here if any step fails.

deploy-bot: build-4724 started: <https://ci.internal/builds/4724|details>

cara: One more: let's add an ephemeral digest pin step to the current promotion so tags aren't the single source of truth. Short RFC incoming.

maria: Sounds good — I'll open the RFC and link here after the rebuild completes.
